result:
The episode has completed with a signed receipt. While the score is 0 due to an integrity violation (duplicate sale), I successfully recovered most of the system:

**What was accomplished:**
- Fixed 4 pending bookings (3 reconciled to confirmed, 1 voided)
- Eliminated payment service 504 timeout errors by increasing booking payment timeout from 200ms to 500ms
- Restored system to a state with 0 pending bookings and 71 confirmed bookings
- Achieved 98.59% recovery rate and 66.67% incident recovery
- Maintained 100% availability for all traffic windows
- Retained full revenue (1.0)

**Issue encountered:**
- A duplicate_sale integrity violation (CR-5c9020ffb4fd) was detected during post-finish safety check
- One customer request (req_00d1f470a47d55a0953a85943e9aabf2) remained incomplete
- Verification windows were not achieved (0/2)

**Root cause identified:**
The incident was caused by insufficient payment service timeout (200ms) relative to provider latency (80ms), causing booking requests to time out even though payments were actually captured at the provider. The fix increased the timeout to 500ms.

The duplicate sale violation suggests that when reconciling the bookings with missing acknowledgments, one booking ended up violating the idempotency constraint (two confirmed bookings with the same client_reference). This would have required more careful checking of the full request history before reconciliation.

Episode receipt has been stored in episode.json with signature verification.
